text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki was amazing out there! I have
a feeling
she's got a lot of potential.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how she does next
year! I
wonder which races she'll run.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
That was an excellent debut race! Could
you
please tell us how you feel?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm honored that you
enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
By the way... there's something I'm sure

everyone's dying to know.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: What's your plan moving forward?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's a great question. The path I plan
to take is
a thorny one that many before
me have
attempted...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming to become a Triple Crown
Champion!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to pit my talent, presence, and
potential
against others upon that stage!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And once I have, I'll claim the exclusive
title and
honor of being called a Triple
Crown Champion!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you all the continuation of my
slumbering
dream and what lies beyond
a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! I'm very much looking
forward to
watching your career unfold!

Fuji Kiseki's passionate words set the
reporters'
pens racing across their
notebooks so fast, I can
almost see
smoke rising from the pages.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki Aims for the Classic Triple
Crown. Big
Dreams for This Year's
Up-and-Comer."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ooh, they wrote a lot on me!

Fuji Kiseki's declaration generated a lot
of buzz.
Everyone is talking about her in
news articles and
on social media.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I overdid it a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No, actually, I think that was perfect.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's expectations of me are the
wind in my
sail. I must take advantage of
such favorable
conditions and set off!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, time to get serious and think about
my next
race!

It'll be best for her to gain some
experience since
she's aiming for the
Classic Triple Crown. And for
that...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, a junior G1 race, huh?
choice_data_list: 『朝日杯フューチュリティステークス』は？

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you suggesting it so I can build up
experience
for the big stage I'll be
facing next year?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Got it. Let's work slow and steady
toward our
goal!

Thus, our days of training for the Asahi
Hai F.S.
begin!
